name: Position-only Chord with original scalar constraints
tagline: Normalized position generates the original six Chord controls.
description: A position-only token projection with softplus position steps, sigmoid velocity retention and direct signed lookahead and write gains.
mechanism: Normalized position conditions each token gate
Original scalar activations and bias initialization
Physical velocity in the lookahead and tangent update
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.
